zh-CN.tip.sessionFiles: 加载当前会话中的 Verilog 文件
zh-CN.tip.importLib: 导入自定义工艺文件（.lib），仅保存在本浏览器，不上传
zh-CN.tip.delLib: 从本浏览器移除该工艺文件
zh-CN.tip.top: 综合顶层模块名，留空自动推断
zh-CN.wave.empty1: 点击「仿真」后，波形将显示在这里。
zh-CN.wave.empty2: 在左侧选择要显示的信号。
zh-CN.sch.empty: 点击「综合」后，设计结构将渲染为原理图。可用左上角按钮或滚轮缩放，拖动平移。
zh-CN.hint.schNav: 滚轮缩放 · 拖动平移
zh-CN.rpt.title: 综合报告
zh-CN.rpt.placeholder: 点击「综合」，将设计映射到所选工艺并生成单元与面积统计。
zh-CN.rpt.flowNote: 门级网表见「门级网表」标签页，结构原理图见「原理图」。
zh-CN.netlist.empty: 综合后在此显示门级网表。
zh-CN.flow.generic: 解析设计 → 层次展开 → 优化 → 通用门级映射
zh-CN.flow.fpga: 解析设计 → 映射到 {tech} 工艺单元 → 优化
zh-CN.flow.asic: 解析设计 → 通用映射 → {lib} 标准单元映射 → 优化
zh-CN.status.simBusy: 仿真中…（页面可能短暂无响应）
zh-CN.synth.overlaySub: 首次加载约 50 MB，请稍候，之后自动缓存
zh-CN.synth.overlayComputingHint: 复杂设计可能耗时较长，页面可能短暂无响应
zh-CN.log.vcdLoaded: 波形已加载：{n} 个信号，时长 {dur}{ts}
zh-CN.log.noVcd: 未生成波形，可在代码中加入 $dumpfile/$dumpvars 记录
zh-CN.log.synthStart: 开始综合：顶层模块 {top} · 工艺 {tech}
zh-CN.log.tbDropped: 综合前已移除仅用于仿真的模块：{list}
zh-CN.log.exampleLoaded: 已加载示例：{name}，之前的结果已清空。
zh-CN.log.sessionFilesFail: 读取会话文件列表失败：{msg}
zh-CN.log.techSwitched: 综合工艺已切换：{label}（下次「综合」生效）
zh-CN.log.libImported: 工艺库 {name}（{size} MB）已保存在本浏览器（不上传），综合时选择该工艺即可。
zh-CN.log.libDeleted: 已移除本机缓存的工艺库 {name}
zh-CN.log.libMissing: 本机缓存的工艺文件不存在，已切回通用门级。
zh-CN.log.vendorFail: 原理图组件加载失败，仿真/综合不受影响。
zh-CN.log.srcFallback: 部分资源自动切换到备用源…
zh-CN.init.hint: 提示：首次综合需加载计算引擎（约 50 MB），请耐心等待。
zh-CN.err.builtinMissing: 该内置工艺暂未就绪，请联系管理员部署，或导入自定义工艺文件。
zh-CN.err.libLoadFail: 工艺库加载失败，请检查网络后重试，或联系管理员。
zh-CN.err.libNotCached: 本机找不到工艺文件：{name}，请重新导入
zh-CN.err.notLiberty: 文件格式不符，请选择 Liberty (.lib) 工艺文件
zh-CN.confirm.delLib: 从本浏览器移除工艺文件 {name}？
zh-CN.res.codeUpdated: 代码已更新，之前的结果已清空
zh-CN.log.libCachedLocal: 工艺库已命中本机缓存
zh-CN.log.libReady: 工艺库就绪（{size} MB），已缓存到本机
zh-CN.err.noTop: 未找到顶层模块，请在代码中定义模块
zh-CN.log.busyTimeout: 运行超时（超过 3 分钟未响应），已自动复位 busy 状态。

en-US.tip.sessionFiles: Load Verilog files from the current session
en-US.tip.tech: Select the target process for synthesis
en-US.tip.importLib: Import a custom process file (.lib); stored only in this browser, never uploaded
en-US.tip.delLib: Remove this process file from this browser
en-US.tip.top: Top module for synthesis; leave empty to auto-detect
en-US.wave.empty1: Click “Simulate” and the waveform will appear here.
en-US.wave.empty2: Select signals to display on the left.
en-US.wave.cursorHint: Click the waveform to place a cursor
en-US.sch.empty: Click “Synthesize” and the design will be rendered as a schematic. Use the top-left buttons or the wheel to zoom, drag to pan.
en-US.hint.schNav: Wheel to zoom · drag to pan
en-US.rpt.title: Synthesis Report
en-US.rpt.placeholder: Click “Synthesize” to map the design onto the selected process and generate cell and area statistics.
en-US.rpt.flowNote: See the “Gate Netlist” tab for the netlist and “Schematic” for the structural view.
en-US.netlist.empty: The gate-level netlist will appear here after synthesis.
en-US.flow.generic: Parse → elaborate hierarchy → optimize → generic gate mapping
en-US.flow.asic: Parse → generic mapping → {lib} standard-cell mapping → optimize
en-US.synth.overlaySub: About 50 MB on first load; cached afterwards
en-US.synth.overlayComputingHint: Complex designs may take a while; the page may freeze briefly
en-US.log.noVcd: No waveform generated; add $dumpfile/$dumpvars to record one
en-US.log.techSwitched: Synthesis process switched: {label} (takes effect on next “Synthesize”)
en-US.log.libImported: Process library {name} ({size} MB) saved in this browser (never uploaded). Select it as the process to use.
en-US.log.libMissing: Cached process file not found; switched back to generic gates.
en-US.log.vendorFail: Schematic components failed to load; simulation and synthesis are unaffected.
en-US.log.srcFallback: Some resources switched to backup sources…
en-US.init.hint: Note: the first synthesis loads the compute engine (~50 MB); please be patient.
en-US.err.builtinMissing: This built-in process is not available yet. Ask the administrator to deploy it, or import your own process file.
en-US.err.libLoadFail: Failed to load the process library. Check your network and retry, or contact the administrator.
en-US.err.libNotCached: Process file not found on this device: {name}. Please re-import it.
en-US.err.notLiberty: Unrecognized format; please choose a Liberty (.lib) process file
en-US.confirm.delLib: Remove process file {name} from this browser?
en-US.log.libCachedLocal: Process library served from local cache
en-US.log.libReady: Process library ready ({size} MB), cached locally
en-US.err.noTop: No top module found; please define a module in the code
en-US.log.busyTimeout: Execution timed out (no response after 3 minutes), busy state auto-reset.
